created_by.product: ChatGPT Work Mode with GitHub connector

title: M0 first specialist council cycle
objective: Collect four distinct, schema-valid specialist artifacts needed to review the Program OS and unlock evidence-backed architecture synthesis without paid APIs or consumer UI automation.
non_goals: Do not merge PR #1 or write directly to main.
Do not enable billing, paid APIs, production infrastructure, or external messages.
Do not synthesize architecture v1 before all four specialist tasks are at least REVIEW.
Do not let one AI impersonate or complete another AI's task.

constraints.text: Incremental monetary cost is zero and billing remains disabled.
Heavy inference is cloud-side; the owner computer is not an inference host.
Consumer UI, cookie, and session automation is forbidden.
STRICT_ZERO_CARD remains the safe draft infrastructure default pending Christian's acceptance.
PR #1 is draft, conflict-free, and has no independent reviews at mission creation.

success_criteria.text: Claude returns UJ-RUN-001 as a schema-valid ResponsePacket with a runtime blueprint artifact.
success_criteria.verification: Importer admits the packet and Gemini can independently review it.

success_criteria.text: Gemini returns separate UJ-CAP-001 and UJ-GGL-001 ResponsePackets with primary-source evidence.
success_criteria.verification: Importer admits both packets and preserves their separate weights.

success_criteria.text: Grok returns UJ-RED-001 with a testable falsification report and remediation for each material finding.
success_criteria.verification: Importer admits the packet and ChatGPT can independently review it.

success_criteria.text: No packet reports paid API, billing, consumer UI automation, secret handling, direct main write, or heavy local inference.
success_criteria.verification: Policy attestations and import checks pass.

success_criteria.text: All accepted synthesis claims preserve source response, artifact hash, and unresolved dissent.
success_criteria.verification: A later SynthesisPacket passes deterministic reconciliation; this mission does not self-declare that result.

stop_conditions: A secret value, billing prompt, paid API requirement, or unauthorized external side effect is encountered.
The target cannot distinguish its actual capabilities from unverified product claims.
The card is expired, revoked, replayed with different bytes, or its input hashes do not match.
The task would require consumer UI automation, direct main write, or heavy local inference.
